तुज् m. (-तुक्) Offspring, children.
 E. तुज् to guard, affix क्विप्.

तुज r. 1st cl. (तोजति) To kill or hurt. (इ) तुजि r. 1st cl. (तुञ्जति) To
guard or protect. r. 1st and 10th cls. (तुञ्जति तुञ्जयति-ते)
 1. To
[]
dwell, to abide.
 2. To be strong or vigorous.
 3. To give.
 4. To
hurt, to injure or kill.
 4. To shine.
 E. प्रापणे हिंसायां च भ्वा० प० सक०
बले इदित् सेट् । चुरा० उभ० अक० सेट् ।
